description: Captured Quest hand motion replay data normalized to each wrist. Room coordinates, timestamps, visibility and device identifiers are omitted.

captured-pinch.description: Captured physical pinch with 3-5 mm thumb/index separation on both hands.

captured-close.description: Captured partial finger closure, not a full fist. Left closure is approximately 55/60/30 degrees and right closure approximately 57/15/7 degrees for index/middle/ring.

captured-fist.description: Owner-confirmed held fists with thumbs across the fingers. Five stable tracked frames averaged per side, normalized to the wrist. Both hands have fully flexed proximal, intermediate and distal joints.

captured-thumb-rest.description: Right thumb resting across the closed fist, captured November 6 after v7.

captured-thumb-slide.description: Right thumb sliding down the palm side of the closed fingers (IP about 52 degrees), captured November 6.
